text:
mikaela: alert-bot flagged an ~18% drop in onboarding cohort 'neo-rt' account health scores since 03:00 UTC. Seeing lots of 'no-owner' and 'missed-nudge' signals. Can cs-ops triage? :eyes:
automation-bot: [ALERT] healthscore-anomaly detected for cohort=neo-rt, delta=-18%, triggered=2026-03-23T03:06:12Z
sam.csops: saw it. preliminary look shows playbook nudges suppressed after the debounce change last deploy. I can pull the missed list. @nora can you take owner reassignment priority if needed?
nora: taking. also noticed the playbook-debounce flag was bumped in last night's deploy. pinging @jared.product and @eli.eng to confirm intent. this cohort is high-touch.
jared.product: we did increase debounce from 30m -> 2h to cut down duplicate nudges for large accounts. that rollout targeted global by default. didn't think it would impact small onboarding cohorts.
eli.eng: that was intended broad change. we have a cohort-level override available via feature flag. quick command to toggle for a cohort: `./rctl flag set playbook.debounce=30m --target cohort:neo-rt` (or via Console -> Flags -> playbook.debounce). need approval to flip for the cohort.
mikaela: approve the toggle for cohort:neo-rt. after toggle, cs-ops to run a controlled backfill of missed nudges limited to non-enterprise accounts. follow backfill runbook.
sam.csops: will run query and backfill. my check query: ```sql
SELECT account_id, owner_id, missed_nudges
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE cohort='neo-rt' AND event_time > '2026-03-23T03:00:00Z' AND nudges_sent=0;
```
automation-bot: Deploy log: playbook-debounce flag changed by eli.eng at 2026-03-23T02:47:12Z (reason: reduce duplicate alerts). Rollback window: 4h.
nora: agree with targeted rollback. also propose safelist rule: don't auto-nudge accounts with account_tier='enterprise' and last_touch < 24h to avoid double-notifying sales-handled customers.
jared.product: agree. i'll open a small ruleset PR to add enterprise safelist and a staging test. ETA ~2h.
eli.eng: toggling now for cohort override -> starting canary 10% for cohort then 100% if healthy. i'll post progress.
automation-bot: Flag toggle event: cohort:neo-rt -> playbook.debounce=30m completed at 2026-03-23T03:12:09Z by eli.eng.
sam.csops: query results: 24 accounts matched; 2 are enterprise and will be skipped. starting backfill for 22 accounts with runbook 'backfill-safeguard-v1' (safeguard: idempotent, max-1-nudge-per-12h). kicking off now.
mikaela: good. file a short incident note if >50 accounts affected. I'll notify customer success leads and watch CS queue.
sam.csops: backfill finished: 22 nudges queued, 22 delivered, 0 errors. summary posted to #cs-ops.
mikaela: marking this resolved for now. follow-ups: @jared.product + @eli.eng to build a small harness to simulate debounce effects on cohorts (test matrix: cohort size, account_tier). create ticket and backlog. tagging @pm-ops for prioritization. :thumbsup:
jared.product: creating ticket CS-4321, assigning to devex + eng. will include test scenarios and metric gating.
pm-ops: acknowledged, will prioritize for next sprint if impact > low. thanks for quick triage.
